_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Purple and Blue#000.dst: 到 {p} 附近 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 與 Korun 交談。

Purple and Blue#001.src: W-Woah there, short nose! What are you doing, barging into my home?!
Purple and Blue#001.dst: 哇——喂，短鼻子！你在幹什麼，就這樣闖進我家？！
Purple and Blue#001.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#002.src: Did {p} send you? Well, welcome to {p}! I could actually make use of some assistance.
Purple and Blue#002.dst: 是 {p} 派你來的？好吧，歡迎來到 {p}！我這裡剛好可以用得上一點幫手。
Purple and Blue#002.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#003.src: The magic here in this place is so potent; you can actually see the mystical properties!
Purple and Blue#003.dst: 這地方的魔力濃到不可思議；那些神祕的性質你甚至可以直接看見！
Purple and Blue#003.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#004.src: I've been a scientist for many years, but I have never seen anything like this lake.
Purple and Blue#004.dst: 我當了很多年的科學家，但從沒見過像這座湖一樣的東西。
Purple and Blue#004.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#005.src: That's why I set up a small laboratory and started living here to study the place. It's pretty rudimentary but it does the job done.
Purple and Blue#005.dst: 所以我才在這裡搭了間小實驗室，住下來研究這個地方。設備很簡陋，但夠用了。
Purple and Blue#005.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#006.src: The deeper into the lake you dive, the stronger the magical power becomes. I think something strange is occurring in the heart of the lake. I believe a lot of answers lie inside.
Purple and Blue#006.dst: 往湖裡潛得越深，魔力就越強。我認為湖心正在發生某種奇怪的事。我相信很多答案就藏在那裡面。
Purple and Blue#006.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#007.src: Alright, that's enough context! You see, there's another... "scientist" across the lake. We're kind of rivals? The guy's awful, I hate him, AND... Well...
Purple and Blue#007.dst: 好了，背景說夠了！是這樣的，湖的另一邊還有一個……「科學家」。我們算是對手吧？那傢伙很討厭，我恨他，而且……嗯……
Purple and Blue#007.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#009.src: And while I somewhat hope he's gotten himself in trouble, he might've figured something out about the lake.
Purple and Blue#009.dst: 雖然我某方面還挺希望他是自己惹上了麻煩，但他也可能真的查出了這座湖的什麼線索。
Purple and Blue#009.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#010.src: There's a note here. You start reading it...
Purple and Blue#010.dst: 這裡有一張筆記。你開始讀了起來……

Purple and Blue#011.src: IMPORTANT NOTES: The map to the talisman is in the basement!! That fool Korun will never see all this coming.
Purple and Blue#011.dst: 重要筆記: 通往護符的地圖在地下室！！Korun 那個蠢貨絕對料不到這一切。

Purple and Blue#012.src: If everything goes right, it should grant access to the heart of the mountain... I can't wait!
Purple and Blue#012.dst: 如果一切順利，它應該能讓我進入這座山的心臟……我等不及了！

Purple and Blue#013.src: It looks like there are extra notes on the back. What should you do?
Purple and Blue#013.dst: 背面好像還寫了別的筆記。你該怎麼做？

Purple and Blue#014.src: I needn't forget to input the total number of lit candles inside the house in order to get in the basement... That's why I made that tube! I'm so good at handling security!! No need for blasted overpriced Corkian equipment!
Purple and Blue#014.dst: 要進地下室，可別忘了輸入屋裡點著的蠟燭總數……所以我才做了那根管子！我對保全真是太在行了！！才不需要那些貴得要命的 Corkian 鬼設備！

Purple and Blue#015.src: You read what's behind the note...
Purple and Blue#015.dst: 你讀起筆記背面的內容……

Purple and Blue#016.src: I actually don't know if I'm making it out of this, but I absolutely have to find out what's inside the lake.
Purple and Blue#016.dst: 其實我也不知道自己能不能活著回來，但我非得弄清楚湖裡到底有什麼不可。

Purple and Blue#017.src: One part of me wants to bring Korun along. As much as we hate each other, it'd surely increase our chance of survival.
Purple and Blue#017.dst: 我心裡有一部分想把 Korun 一起帶去。雖然我們彼此討厭得要命，但那肯定能提高我們活下來的機會。

Purple and Blue#018.src: And, who knows, maybe the heart of the mountain is actually perfectly safe?
Purple and Blue#018.dst: 而且誰知道呢，說不定這座山的心臟其實安全得很？

Purple and Blue#019.src: Though, I mustn't forget that three of the greatest minds of our time got lost to cosmic powers...
Purple and Blue#019.dst: 不過我可不能忘了，我們這個時代最頂尖的三個頭腦，都葬送在宇宙力量之下……

Purple and Blue#020.src: No matter what, if you really want to join me, I left you enough clues.
Purple and Blue#020.dst: 無論如何，如果你真的想跟上來，我留給你的線索夠多了。

Purple and Blue#023.src: This map seems to lead towards a particular location nearby...
Purple and Blue#023.dst: 這張地圖似乎指向附近的某個地點……

Purple and Blue#024.src: Some mechanisms can be heard... There's probably another lever to press.
Purple and Blue#024.dst: 聽得見某些機關運作的聲音……大概還有另一根拉桿要扳。

Purple and Blue#025.src: Upon touching the crystal, you notice a peculiar device...
Purple and Blue#025.dst: 一碰到水晶，你就注意到一個奇特的裝置……

Purple and Blue#027.src: The crystal finished forming something, you should retrieve it.
Purple and Blue#027.dst: 水晶凝成了某樣東西，你該把它取走。

Purple and Blue#029.src: Looks like you can leave this place now.
Purple and Blue#029.dst: 看來你現在可以離開這裡了。

Purple and Blue#031.src: I suspect he's gone in to the heart of the lake... Come with me a moment, please.
Purple and Blue#031.dst: 我懷疑他進到湖心去了……請你跟我來一下。
Purple and Blue#031.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#032.src: Alright, this leads underwater where the heart is. How about you try and enter?
Purple and Blue#032.dst: 好，這條路通往水下的湖心。你要不要試著進去看看？
Purple and Blue#032.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#033.src: ...just as I thought, you can't get in just like me. We'll need to gather more information.
Purple and Blue#033.dst: ……跟我想的一樣，你跟我一樣進不去。我們得再蒐集更多情報。
Purple and Blue#033.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#034.src: Human, investigate Nikoler's house for me. It's north down the coast.
Purple and Blue#034.dst: 人類，替我去調查 Nikoler 的房子。就在北邊沿著海岸走。
Purple and Blue#034.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#035.src: Where could he be... There's no way he found access to- Hey!
Purple and Blue#035.dst: 他會在哪呢……他不可能找到進去的方法才對——喂！
Purple and Blue#035.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#036.src: Don't just listen to me mumbling! Have you found Nikoler?!
Purple and Blue#036.dst: 別光聽我在那邊碎念！你到底找到 Nikoler 沒有？！
Purple and Blue#036.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#037.src: Investigate Nikoler's house for clues at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Purple and Blue#037.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 調查 Nikoler 的房子，尋找線索。

Purple and Blue#038.src: Follow the hints in the cellar to the mysterious cave.
Purple and Blue#038.dst: 照著地窖裡的線索找到那個神祕洞穴。

Purple and Blue#039.src: Enter and explore the mysterious cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Purple and Blue#040.src: Return to Korun in his home at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Purple and Blue#040.dst: 回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的家中找 Korun。

Purple and Blue#041.src: Y-you've actually found a lead?! There were clues in his basement? And you found a... talisman? This must be it, then!
Purple and Blue#041.dst: 你、你真的找到線索了？！他地下室裡有線索？而且你還找到一個……護符？那這一定就是了！
Purple and Blue#041.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#042.src: This might very well be the key to enter the heart, especially if it was as well-guarded with cosmic creatures as you say.
Purple and Blue#042.dst: 這說不定就是進入湖心的鑰匙，尤其如果它真像你說的，被那些宇宙生物守得那麼嚴實。
Purple and Blue#042.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#043.src: Alright then! This might be too dangerous for me, so I'm entrusting this task to you once more. Enter the tunnel in my basement, and explore as much as you can!
Purple and Blue#043.dst: 那好！這件事對我來說可能太危險了，所以我要再一次把它託付給你。從我地下室的隧道進去，能探多深就探多深！
Purple and Blue#043.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#044.src: If you can bring me samples of any kind, I'll try to reward you handsomely. However, if you find Nikoler alive... Please bring him back.
Purple and Blue#044.dst: 如果你能帶回任何樣本，我會盡量給你優厚的報酬。不過，如果你找到還活著的 Nikoler……請把他帶回來。
Purple and Blue#044.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#045.src: As for the talisman, make sure you hold it whilst in the tunnel. Be careful, you're in uncharted territory from now on.
Purple and Blue#045.dst: 至於那個護符，進隧道的時候記得拿在手上。小心點，從這裡開始就是未知領域了。
Purple and Blue#045.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#046.src: As Korun said, it's probably better to hold that talisman to traverse the tunnel...
Purple and Blue#046.dst: 就像 Korun 說的，穿過隧道時最好把那個護符拿在手上……

Purple and Blue#047.src: Good luck, human. Please bring me back Nikoler, or any sample you might find.
Purple and Blue#047.dst: 祝你好運，人類。請把 Nikoler 帶回來給我，或是任何你找得到的樣本。
Purple and Blue#047.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#048.src: Enter the heart of Gylia from under the lake.
Purple and Blue#048.dst: 從湖底進入 Gylia 之心。

Purple and Blue#050.src: The drill should be ready by now... In just a little bit, I'll have single-handedly conquered the heart of the mountain...!
Purple and Blue#050.dst: 鑽頭現在應該已經備妥了……再過一下子，我就要獨力征服這座山的心臟了……！

Purple and Blue#051.src: A human!? W...What? Did you read the notes I left for Korun? I'll have you know that's theft!! I - you...!
Purple and Blue#051.dst: 人類！？什、什麼？你看了我留給 Korun 的筆記？我告訴你那叫偷竊！！我——你……！
Purple and Blue#051.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#052.src: Don't get any closer!! I'll destroy the path if I have to!!
Purple and Blue#052.dst: 別再靠近了！！必要的話我會把路毀掉！！
Purple and Blue#052.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#053.src: This is MY story! Don't you dare interfere!!
Purple and Blue#053.dst: 這是「我」的故事！你敢插手試試看！！
Purple and Blue#053.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#054.src: You're... persistent. Are you trying to steal from these meteors I'VE found?! Do you have any idea how much research I did to get this far??
Purple and Blue#054.dst: 你還真是……鍥而不捨。你是想從「我」找到的這些隕石上偷東西嗎？！你知不知道我做了多少研究才走到這一步？？
Purple and Blue#054.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#055.src: It's too late! I've already drilled a piece. Once I show Korun, I'll be known as the better researcher...
Purple and Blue#055.dst: 太遲了！我已經鑽下一塊了。只要拿給 Korun 看，我就會被公認是更優秀的研究者……
Purple and Blue#055.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#058.src: No no no no no no! This CAN'T be happening!
Purple and Blue#058.dst: 不不不不不不！這不可能發生！
Purple and Blue#058.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#059.src: Tampering with the meteors must be making the cave instable! I... I thought this'd happen and yet-
Purple and Blue#059.dst: 對隕石動手腳一定讓這個洞穴變得不穩定了！我……我早就想過會這樣，可是——
Purple and Blue#059.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#060.src: This is all YOUR fault! Why'd you have to come and make me panic? We're both DOOMED!
Purple and Blue#060.dst: 這全都是「你」害的！你幹嘛跑來害我慌了手腳？我們兩個都完蛋了！
Purple and Blue#060.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#061.src: No... I can't die here, I can't die now, what will he think...
Purple and Blue#061.dst: 不……我不能死在這裡，我現在不能死，他會怎麼想……
Purple and Blue#061.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#062.src: I... We might still have a shot at escaping... And then, human, I'll report you to the authorities!!
Purple and Blue#062.dst: 我……我們或許還有機會逃出去……然後，人類，我一定要去告發你！！
Purple and Blue#062.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#063.src: I'm STUCK! Urgh... No... Not like this, please, not like this...
Purple and Blue#063.dst: 我卡住了！唔……不……別是這樣，拜託，別是這樣……
Purple and Blue#063.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#064.src: You... Why? You came to get me? Not the... meteors?
Purple and Blue#064.dst: 你……為什麼？你是來救我的？不是為了……隕石？
Purple and Blue#064.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#065.src: I... Fine then. Let's make a run for it, human!
Purple and Blue#065.dst: 我……好吧。人類，我們一起衝出去！
Purple and Blue#065.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#067.src: Rats! That dynamite went and backfired on us! Quick, try to run in to the rubble with me, we need to hurry!
Purple and Blue#067.dst: 可惡！那炸藥反倒炸到我們自己了！快，跟我一起衝進碎石堆，我們得快點！
Purple and Blue#067.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#069.src: Welcome back! I see you're completely drenched! How did things go? I assume you've explored the place thoroughly.
Purple and Blue#069.dst: 歡迎回來！我看你全身都濕透了！情況怎麼樣？我想你應該把那地方徹底探過一遍了。
Purple and Blue#069.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#071.src: ...were you worrying about me? What a fool. This mountain could never do so much as scratch me!
Purple and Blue#071.dst: ……你剛剛是在擔心我嗎？真是個傻子。這座山連我一根寒毛都傷不了！
Purple and Blue#071.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#072.src: This human right here actually saved me, right after endangering me. You don't mean to tell me you sent them for me?
Purple and Blue#072.dst: 我旁邊這個人類其實救了我一命，雖然也是這位先把我害到那步田地的。你該不會是要說，人是你派來找我的吧？
Purple and Blue#072.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#073.src: Well, it's very simple. Where's the fun in our rivalry if you just go off and die somewhere?
Purple and Blue#073.dst: 這很簡單啊。你要是自己跑去哪裡死掉了，我們這場較勁還有什麼樂趣可言？
Purple and Blue#073.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#074.src: That aside, what did you find in there? What happened?
Purple and Blue#074.dst: 這先不談，你在裡面找到什麼了？發生了什麼事？
Purple and Blue#074.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#075.src: I found them, Korun. I found the meteors! They still seemed potent somehow, but the cave collapsed and...
Purple and Blue#075.dst: 我找到了，Korun。我找到那些隕石了！它們不知怎地似乎還帶著強大的力量，可是洞穴塌了，然後……
Purple and Blue#075.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#076.src: That's... fine. We can always go back and try clearing the rubble. There's always opportunities to take a hold of. Next time, please don't just go off on your own!
Purple and Blue#076.dst: 那……沒關係。我們隨時可以再回去試著把碎石清掉。機會永遠都在，就看你抓不抓得住。下次拜託別再自己一個人跑掉了！
Purple and Blue#076.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#077.src: Human, you made the right choice... Without Nikoler, our efforts would have been in vain. I'll try to work with him a bit more, as it seems like the logical course of action now. Thank you.
Purple and Blue#077.dst: 人類，你做了正確的選擇……少了 Nikoler，我們的努力都會白費。看來現在合乎邏輯的做法就是跟他多合作一點了。謝謝你。
Purple and Blue#077.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#078.dst: 欸、欸！我可從來沒答應要——
Purple and Blue#078.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#079.src: I see you're completely drenched! There's this odd aura around you... What happened?
Purple and Blue#079.dst: 我看你全身都濕透了！你身上還有一股奇怪的氣息……發生什麼事了？
Purple and Blue#079.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#080.src: You... You actually found a meteor shard! That's amazing! That's... that's... um...
Purple and Blue#080.dst: 你……你居然真的找到了一塊隕石碎片！太驚人了！那……那……呃……
Purple and Blue#080.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#081.src: Uh, what did you say j-just now? The cave collapsed and Nikoler d-died...?
Purple and Blue#081.dst: 呃，你、你剛剛說什麼？洞穴塌了，Nikoler 他、他死了……？
Purple and Blue#081.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#082.src: That's, um, haha... That doesn't sound right, he can't die, he can't leave like that, he can't-
Purple and Blue#082.dst: 那個，呃，哈哈……這聽起來不對啊，他不會死的，他不可能就這樣走掉，他不會——
Purple and Blue#082.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#083.src: S-Sorry. I'm just a little shocked is all. I do have to thank you for the shard...
Purple and Blue#083.dst: 抱、抱歉。我只是有點震驚而已。碎片的事我還是得謝謝你……
Purple and Blue#083.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#084.src: A-at the very least, you saw this through... I have to commend you for that... I think.
Purple and Blue#084.dst: 至、至少你把這件事做完了……這一點我得稱讚你……我想。
Purple and Blue#084.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#085.src: Just take these, and go. I have much to think about.
Purple and Blue#085.dst: 這些你拿去，然後走吧。我有很多事要想。
Purple and Blue#085.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#086.src: You explored thoroughly, and couldn't find a shard? Well, we still have much to discover I suppose.
Purple and Blue#086.dst: 你徹底探過了，卻找不到碎片？唉，看來我們要發現的東西還多著呢。
Purple and Blue#086.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#087.src: Uh, what did you say j-just now? The cave collapsed and Nikoler d-died..?
Purple and Blue#087.dst: 呃，你、你剛剛說什麼？洞穴塌了，Nikoler 他、他死了……？
Purple and Blue#087.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#088.src: S-Sorry. I'm just a little shocked is all. And you came back empty-handed... This was just a loss with everyone involved.
Purple and Blue#088.dst: 抱、抱歉。我只是有點震驚而已。而且你還兩手空空回來……這下所有人都是輸家了。
Purple and Blue#088.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#089.src: I see you're completely drenched, so I suppose you thoroughly explored the place. How did it go?
Purple and Blue#089.dst: 我看你全身都濕透了，那我想你應該把那地方徹底探過了。情況怎麼樣？
Purple and Blue#089.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#090.src: You found... Nothing? Really? And the meteors were too unstable to temper with?
Purple and Blue#090.dst: 你什麼……都沒找到？真的？而且那些隕石不穩定到沒辦法動手腳？
Purple and Blue#090.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#091.src: Actually, how would you know about tempering with the- wait...
Purple and Blue#091.dst: 話說回來，你怎麼會知道能不能動手腳——等一下……
Purple and Blue#091.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#092.src: Did you find him? Please... please tell me you found him, there's no way he'd die just like that. I...
Purple and Blue#092.dst: 你找到他了嗎？拜託……拜託告訴我你找到他了，他不可能就這樣死掉的。我……
Purple and Blue#092.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#093.src: W-what? The whole cave COLLAPSED on him? And you couldn't even save him?! N-no, it can't be your fault, I... I'm sorry.
Purple and Blue#093.dst: 什、什麼？整個洞穴塌在他身上？而且你連救都救不了他？！不、不對，這不能怪你，我……我很抱歉。
Purple and Blue#093.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#094.src: This is all way too much to take in for me, but I suppose you've explored and served the purpose I gave you.
Purple and Blue#094.dst: 這些事我一時之間實在消化不了，不過我想你確實探索過了，也完成了我交給你的任務。
Purple and Blue#094.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#095.src: Here's your reward, then. Now please, just leave me be. There's a lot I have to think about.
Purple and Blue#095.dst: 那這是你的報酬。現在拜託，讓我一個人靜一靜。我有很多事要想。
Purple and Blue#095.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#096.src: It's you! Glad to have crossed paths again!
Purple and Blue#096.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#097.src: Since the incident, I've decided to start fishing as a hobby.
Purple and Blue#097.dst: 那件事之後，我決定開始把釣魚當興趣。
Purple and Blue#097.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#098.src: Take this- for all I care, you can own this!
Purple and Blue#098.dst: 這個拿去——我一點都不在乎，你留著吧！
Purple and Blue#098.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#100.src: Check up on Korun from time to time for me, will you?
Purple and Blue#100.dst: 幫我三不五時去看看 Korun，好嗎？
Purple and Blue#100.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#101.src: I'm still taking a break from all the science stuff... But he definitely hasn't seen the last of me!
Purple and Blue#101.dst: 科學那一套我還在休息當中……不過他絕對還會再見識到我的！
Purple and Blue#101.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#102.src: After all, I'm the one who got to the heart of the mountain! I'm even able to sleep soundly knowing that I've won...
Purple and Blue#102.dst: 畢竟，抵達那座山心臟的人是我！光是知道自己贏了，我連覺都睡得特別香……
Purple and Blue#102.speaker: Nikoler
